subject: Request: credit exception for Pangea deal — roadmap dependency
messages:
From: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@pangea.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@pangea.io>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up on PoC and onboarding credits

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for the demo last week. The team is excited about Redwood, but we're hitting a blocker on our side: we need a hosted VPC + SSO connector and a managed embeddings cache to meet our security team's onboarding checklist. I understand those items are on your roadmap but not GA yet.

Given that gap, Procurement asked whether Redwood can provide an onboarding credit or one-time discount to offset the additional integration effort while we commit to a 12-month Dedicated contract and a vendor security review timeline. Broad ask: up to $50k in credits applied in the first quarter post-go-live, or an equivalent upfront discount.

Our timeline is tight — procurement wants a signed SOW by the end of April to hit a May launch window. Can you confirm whether Redwood is able to commit credits conditioned on a roadmap milestone? If so, what approvals are needed?

Attached is a short SOW and our procurement outline. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Jamie Liu
Director, Platform Integrations
Pangea

Attachment: pangea_milestone_SOW.pdf (1 page summary)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@pangea.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up on PoC and onboarding credits

Thanks Jamie — and cc'ing product and finance so we can align.

Short answer: we want to support Pangea and close this in Q2. We can consider a conditional credit tied to the feature milestone, but we need product to confirm the delivery window for the VPC/SSO + embeddings cache, and finance to confirm limits/structure (credit vs. discount).

Marissa — can you confirm the ETA for a beta for the VPC+SSO integration and a managed embeddings cache? If GA is beyond May, what minimal rollout commitments could we offer that would satisfy procurement (e.g., beta access + documented milestone date)?

Rishi — fyi on the ask: $50k equivalent in credits; will likely need a discount/credit exception review. What approvals are required for credits of that magnitude?

Jamie — I'll coordinate internally and circle back with a proposal and required signoffs. If acceptable, we can draft a milestone-conditioned SOW and DocuSign flow.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Director | Redwood Inference
Cell: (555) 614-0221

Subject: Re: Follow-up on PoC and onboarding credits — roadmap status

Hi all — quick product update on the items called out.

Status summary:
- Hosted VPC + SSO connector: Beta planned 2026-04-15, GA targeted mid-May. Beta will include SAML-based SSO and basic network isolation.
- Managed embeddings cache: initial release (read-through cache for embeddings) planned for beta 2026-04-22, GA early June.

Notes/context: these dates are firm for our Q2 roadmap but dependent on a short validation cycle in late April. We can offer Pangea beta access (early onboarding) and dedicated support to speed validation. That would allow you to proceed against procurement conditions if procurement accepts beta access + milestone gating for GA.

Proposal for the credit request: Product is comfortable with a conditional credit structure tied to two milestones:
1) Beta activation (Pangea acceptance testing started) — release 50% of credits
2) GA availability + integration checklist complete — remaining 50% credited

I will prioritize the validation path if we have a clear commercial commitment (12-month Dedicated, expected start date) and a signed milestone-based SOW.

Evelyn — I can join a call with Jamie next week to walk through the beta plan and deliverable checklist.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Management — Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

> On Fri, Mar 20, 2026 at 10:03 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> > (internal ask)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Credit request for Pangea — finance constraints and routing

Evelyn/Marissa — thanks for looping finance in. A few points from our side:

- Credit vs discount: finance prefers a credit applied to the account (usable against usage/overages) rather than a permanent list-price reduction. Credits are easier from a contract and booking perspective.
- Approval thresholds: discounts/credits up to 10% ARR equivalent can be signed off by Sales Ops. Anything between 10-25% requires Finance approval; >25% requires exec approval (CRO/CFO). A $50k one-time credit for the first quarter on a $200k ARR commitment maps to ~25% ARR equivalent, so this likely needs exec signoff.
- Controls: we require milestone gating (as Marissa proposed), an expiration window for credits (six months), and a signed credit_exception_form. I've attached the form and a sample clause for milestone release.

If the team wants to proceed with the proposed structure (50/50 at beta/GA), please confirm the exact credit amount and we will route for signoff. Vivek — adding you here for awareness/approval given the size.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: credit_exception_form.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Credit request for Pangea — approval

Thanks Rishi — reviewed. I'm willing to approve a one-time credit equal to $50,000 tied to the milestone plan below, provided Legal signs the milestone SOW and Procurement agrees to the 12-month Dedicated commitment. Conditions:

- Credit split: 50% on beta activation (Pangea acceptance test start), 50% on GA + integration checklist complete.
- Credits expire 180 days after issuance if unused.
- Redwood reserves right to revoke beta access if integration work reveals security/regulatory gaps.
- Legal to attach a short schedule to the Master SaaS Agreement documenting the credit release criteria.

Please proceed to generate the milestone-conditioned SOW and route to Legal and Procurement for signature. Finance to prepare accounting treatment. Evelyn — coordinate DocuSign.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
